$comment: Brimhaven Dungeon vines (plugins/areas/brimhavendungeon/Vines.BrimhavenDungeon.js). Levels and the cut chance per axe tier are the OSRS Wiki's (Vines (Brimhaven Dungeon)); the chart is the normal tree's (the same numbers as Woodcutting's CUT_CHANCE.normal, which isn't shared), and crystal axes cut like dragon as in Woodcutting. `outer` is the side nearer the entrance (found by walking the map from the entrance landing, vine by vine; vines 1, 2, 4 and 5 were also recorded being cut from that side, rsprox 227/90, 91 and 234/3275; vine 3 has no recording): from there an axe and the level are needed, from `inner` neither. The blessed axe doesn't cut them (Wiki, Brimhaven Dungeon).
